up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity records that meet all of the following criteria: the assay target is the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293197 (Acidic mammalian chitinase); the activity standard type is 'IC50'; the standard relation is exactly '='; the pChEMBL value is not null. For each qualifying record, return exactly these columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id (target taxonomy ID), canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (should always be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value. Order the output rows by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Keep only the first 1000 rows overall.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293197' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
